text:
mika: Heads-up from the new model bring-up (q8x2b-int4): we're seeing subtle quality regressions on multi-turn, instruction-heavy prompts in deid-dialogue-holdout. Not just hallucinationsbut also answer truncation and misaligned citations across turns. Need a focused microgolden and a de-dupe/provenance plan.

tara: can you paste the quick eval slices?

mika: pasted below. worst slices: long multi-turn chains and instruction-following where the model should keep earlier context.

```
$ rbin eval --model q8x2b-1.0-int4 --dataset deid-dialogue-holdout --slices long_chats,instruction_following,turn_citation
Turn-consistency: 86.4% (-4.5% vs fp16)
Hallucination-rate: 6.9% (+2.1%)
Truncation-events: 1.9% (+1.2%)
Latency p50: 198ms
```

zane: thanks. do we know if this is quant-only or something with KV-cache/windowing? any change to max_context or chunking?

mika: default serving config used. I did a quick run with kv-cache disabled and the truncation-events dropped 0.3% but turn-consistency stayed down. So KV helps a bit but main delta looks like numeric/attention quant interactions across long sequences and the reproduction of earlier-turn citations.

tara: let's treat as a targeted quality regression. Proposal: build a microgolden focused on multi-turn behavior + citation continuity: 320 examples total -> 200 long multi-turn dialogs (>=6 turns, >700 tokens), 80 instruction-following cases where the instruction applies across turns, 40 adversarial paraphrase variants that shift entity mentions across turns. 3 labelers per item + validator for disagreements.

mika: sampling plan: pull 1.5k candidate threads from last 60 days of RAG traffic (deid-filtered) -> token-shingle fuzzy dedupe (shingle_size=4) -> fingerprinting -> surface 500 candidates -> labeler queue -> finalize 320. Provenance fields: source_ts, session_id, route, md5_text, shingle_hash, turn_ids.

zane: I'll own assembly+d edupe. plan: initial sample -> run fuzzyhash threshold 0.83 -> remove any md5_text in existing golden indexes -> run quick token-overlap filter for turn-alignment -> output 500 candidates and push to LB-12001.

labeler-bot: New ticket created: ML-5021 "q8x2b-int4: multi-turn/dialogue continuity regression". Labeling plan attached.

tara: labeler checklist (ops copy):
1) Verify that answers for each turn only use source content present in prior turns or provided documents.
2) Mark 'turn-miss' if context from earlier turns is missing and should have been used (include smallest evidence span).
3) Mark 'citation-drop' if citation text/IDs present earlier are lost or moved.
4) Mark 'hallucination' if new facts appear not supported by any turn.
5) Severity 0-3 and short rationale. Escalate unmasked PII to privacy-ops.

mika: labeling schema addition: keep a short provenance vector for each example: [session_ts, dialogue_fingerprint, turn_count, route]. This helps quick diffing when we repro later.

zane: on the model side, can we run a quant+kernel+permute sweep capturing per-run turn-alignment metrics? Example command I discussed with runtime team: 

```
rbin quant-sweep --model q8x2b-1.0 --bits 4 --kernels aten,flash,fast_attn --permute none,block,row --kv-cache on,off --eval deid-dialogue-holdout --slices long_chats,instruction_following --save-logs ML-5021/logs
```

labeler-bot: Labeling batch LB-12001 created. ETA first pass 72 hrs.

tara: if a kernel variant recovers turn-consistency we should either pin that kernel for this model or add per-route kernel overrides in Dedicated. If not, try per-layer exceptions (keep attn & layernorm fp16) or hybrid quant for cross-attention matrices. Also update Optimize with a 'dialogue-int4' profile recommending these exceptions for long-chat workloads.

mika: console: please add a dashboard card "dialogue-turn-consistency (deid-dialogue-holdout)" that shows turn-consistency on golden vs prod slices and an alert if it drops >2% week-over-week. Also export microgolden fingerprints and turn-id manifests for quick regressions.

zane: starting assembly+dedupe now; will push artifacts to ML-5021/artifacts and attach a provenance manifest CSV.

labeler-bot: LB-12001 populated with 500 staged candidates -> awaiting labelers.

tara: nora (cc) - can you run the sweep and attach kernel traces? We want per-run kernel fingerprints (kernel+permute+shard_checksum) so runtime can map runs to specific CUDA kernels.

labeler-bot: ML-5021 updated: sweep logs path pending; LB-12001 created.

mika: quick ops copy for labelers to post in the ops channel: "When labeling multi-turns, treat earlier turns as the authoritative source for later answers unless explicitly overridden. Mark turn-miss where context is required but absent; cite the smallest evidence span in earlier turns. For citation-drop, paste original citation text/ID and the model's output. Severity guides: 0=ok,1=tiny,2=medium (affects user outcome),3=high (safety/privacy/risk)."

zane: will ping here when LB-12001 first-pass completes. planning to include a small test harness that can replay the exact serve config for regression repro.

tara: thanks all. action items recap: (1) nora run kernel sweep + upload logs to ML-5021, (2) zane assemble + dedupe + populate LB-12001, (3) labelers start LB-12001, (4) mika file console card + add Optimize profile suggestion. Ping me for unblockers. :white_check_mark:
